structural_adequacy.label: STRUCTURAL_COVERAGE_PASS
structural_adequacy.meaning: All 25 panels are training-library-selected 256-region subsets of the exact counted 465-region union; hashes, dimensions, nonnegative counts, and panel∈union membership hold. Measured zeros are retained.

biological_regulatory_adequacy.label: REGULATORY_ADEQUACY_UNRESOLVED
biological_regulatory_adequacy.meaning: Prevalence/tie-break panels and gene-interval overlaps are descriptive. Overlap counts do not prove regulatory function; missing annotations remain unknown. Cannot authorize a biological regulatory-feature claim.

annotation_sources.selection_rule: per outer fold: top-N exact intervals by that fold's training-library prevalence; ties broken by sha256(salt + '\n' + region) with salt 'p22-atac-tiebreak-v1', then region
annotation_sources.gene_intervals: H5AD raw/var seqnames/start/end (0-based half-open; A9); n_intervals=35440

alternate_representation.representation: Existing gene-activity exact-count panel (configs/nn_gene_activity_2026-09-23.bed + measured counts), already quantified under a separate contract
alternate_representation.reason: Measured deficiency for regulatory questions: fold panels are prevalence-selected intervals without a regulatory-element annotation gate. Gene-linked exact counts reuse existing measurements; no new interval recount and no filling unmeasured peaks with biological zero.
alternate_representation.does_not_authorize: Biological cell-state fit (Q2 ENDPOINT_UNRESOLVED) or regulatory adequacy PASS; remains a candidate representation comparison for Q6+

limits: Structural PASS is not regulatory adequacy.
Gene/TSS overlap counts are not functional regulatory proof.
No unmeasured peaks filled with biological zero.
Q2 ENDPOINT_UNRESOLVED still blocks biological cell-state fits.
